usageNotes: Use this to set the system timezone on a specific Proxmox node. The timezone value must be a valid IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York') — consult /usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab on the node for the full list. Requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}; this operation completes synchronously and returns null on success.

examples.summary: Set the timezone on node pve1 to US Eastern Time

tips: Timezone names are case-sensitive and must exactly match an entry in /usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab on the node.
Changing the timezone affects log timestamps and scheduled tasks on that node; consider restarting time-sensitive services (e.g. cron) after the change.
Use get_nodes_node_time (GET /nodes/{node}/time) to verify the current timezone before and after setting it.
